description: Build a sell for USDG in one call: give tokenId or token, and percent of the wallet balance (read on chain) or an exact amount. Quotes six routers and returns the best route as a transaction to sign. The TRNCH fee (0.5%) is already deducted from the quote. Returns { router, quote, approval, tx, chainId, from }: if approval is not null, send it first, then sign and send tx from the same wallet (chainId 4663). Nothing is sent by TRNCH. Errors: 409 token not tradable through TRNCH (kept out by TIA), 429 rate or build limit (retry-after). Requires the API key from trnch_register, sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

amount.description: Exact amount in token units, e.g. 1234.5. Capped at the balance. Use this or percent.

percent.description: Share of the wallet balance to sell, 100 = all. Use this or amount.

slippageBps.description: Max slippage in basis points (100 = 1%). Default 100.

token.description: Token to sell, as an address. Use this or tokenId.

tokenId.description: Opaque token id from trnch_heat (field id). Use this or token.

name: trnch_sell
title: Sell a token
